This '''Imperial commander''' was in charge of a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]<ref name=":0">[[Star Wars (1977) 68|''Star Wars'' (1977) 68]]</ref> around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> During a trek to lead a group of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] slaves back to the Imperial-held [[City of Bone]], the commander's convoy was attacked by a raiding party led by [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] [[Fenn Shysa]]. The commander tried to stay out of the battle, as he held the controls to all the slaves' [[Energy cuffs|energy links]].<ref name=":0" />

[[File:SlaverDeath.jpg|thumb|left|270x270px|Fenn Shysa kills the slaver commander during a skirmish on Mandalore.]]

However, as the battle grew more fierce, Shysa sought out the commander, blasting him in the chest. The shot destroyed the controls to the energy links and killed the commander in the process. To keep anyone from repairing the controls that Shysa had destroyed, the Mandalorian removed the controls from the dead Imperial's body. While he was in the process of doing this, another slaver trained his blaster on Shysa, hoping to avenge his fallen commander. Before he could succeed, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] killed the would-be avenger, saving Shysa's life.<ref name=":0" />
